Product Details: Fusso Coat is a SEALANT in Wax Format and not only a product to give shine to the vehicle, on a scale of durability and protection, Fusso Coat is closer to a professional glazing than a great synthetic or carnauba wax, of which the latter can be used after the application of FUSSO COAT to optimize the shine of the vehicle in subsequent washes, because FUSSO COAT lasts up to 12 months. Fusso Coat protects your vehicle's varnish and paint against UV rays, dust, acid rain, chemicals, scratches, the action of weather and repels water keeping the surface clean at all times. Just one can of FUSSO COAT 200g can yield up to 40 medium cars, and with the durability of 12 months you will have a product to use for many years, it resists several washes because due to its repellency, the effort to wash the vehicle is less, thus not harming the paint or the sealant (SPINDLE COAT) applied to it. This version is not Cleaner (cleaner) APPLICATION: STEP 1 Wash and dry the vehicle before application; Do not apply the product under the sun or if the surface is heated. STEP 2 Moisten the sponge; Apply and buff in parts, avoiding excessive dryness of the product; It is not necessary to press the sponge hard, just a light pressure. STEP 3 Use the Super Cloth SOFT99 microfiber towel to remove; For a fantastic shine, use the SOFT99 Beauty Cloth "Fox Skin" Towel for Polishing. TIPS: For better fixation of the wax, the ideal is to respect the maturation time (curing) of the wax, about 4 hours without exposure to the sun; Ultra water and dirt repellency, keeping the surface clean at all times
